You're All Access now. Thank you for backing this. You've got the whole thing: all 52 money lessons and every meal-prep recipe. Here's how to get the most out of it.

Where to start

  • The 52-Week Program. The guided path, start to finish. Begin with Week 1.
  • Browse by topic. Jump straight to budgeting, debt, investing, whatever you need right now.
  • Every recipe. Pick one, cook a batch this Sunday, and watch what you stop spending.
  • Your money tools. Make your own copy of the Budget Tracker, plus the savings, compound-interest, and debt-payoff calculators (and four free tools anyone can use).

Make it stick

The whole method is small and repeatable: one short lesson a week, one cook on Sunday. You're not trying to be perfect. You're making the good choice the easy one, and letting it stack.

Good to know

  • Sign in anytime with just your email. No password to remember.
  • Manage your plan or cancel in two clicks from Account. No hoops, ever.

You didn't just buy content. You made a small, smart choice, early. That's the whole idea. Let's build something good.
